# Callouts: Flash backup 10.3 - the LaunchPad's XDS110: TMS, TCK and GND out to the cooker

Source: Own photos, raptox's CC3220S LaunchPad: stitched from photos 04-08 of 2026-11-05 (the jumper caps were still on then)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/fb10-3_launchpad-xds110.jpg](../../../images/annotated/fb10-3_launchpad-xds110.jpg)

Jumper positions counted from the J18 end (VSENSE/BRD): BRD, TDO, TDI, TCK (4th), TMS (5th), RST. Since 2026-11-06 the TMS, TCK, TDI, TDO and RST caps are off. Of each pair the XDS110's pin is the one that beeps to J4 (TMS to pin 2, TCK to pin 4): the left one in this view (likely). GND from TP2. Nothing of the LaunchPad's own 3V3/5V goes to the cooker; USB in last, out first.
